name: the round room on top of the hidden hill building
about: The circular rooftop room of a building disguised as a forested hill in Kalimar, where the team meets Evelor in chapter 27. The book gives only the details listed below; the rest of the design is invented, and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: the houses gave way to what seemed like a deep forest
facts.fact: Reached through a stretch of deep forest.

facts.quote: The path sloped downwards, and led to an entrance door to what seemed to be the inside of the hill.
facts.fact: The entrance is a door into the hill.

facts.quote: they made what was quite possibly an entirely manmade hill look like nature
facts.fact: The hill is probably entirely artificial but looks natural.

facts.quote: led them up a staircase into the middle of a circular area from where they could see the open sky
facts.fact: A staircase rises into the middle of a circular room open to the sky.

facts.quote: a roof started to close above them
facts.fact: A roof slides closed over it.

facts.quote: a bench pressed against the safety railing behind the opening that the staircase emerged from
facts.fact: A safety railing surrounds the stair opening.

facts.quote: the circular bench that was all along the circumference of the room
facts.fact: A circular bench runs all around the room.

facts.quote: slowly climbing up the staircase with a raising motion and then a sliding motion at each step
facts.fact: A serving robot climbs the stairs with tea.

descriptor: a circular room at the summit of an artificial hill so thickly grown with trees and moss that it reads as untouched forest, open to the sky beneath a round roof of sliding petal-shaped segments, a curved bench running all around its smooth stone wall, a safety railing ringing the staircase opening in the center, and soft hidden lights in the rim
plate_prompt: Establishing view of circular room at the summit of an artificial hill so thickly grown with trees and moss that it reads as untouched forest, open to the sky beneath a round roof of sliding petal-shaped segments, a curved bench running all around its smooth stone wall, a safety railing ringing the staircase opening in the center, and soft hidden lights in the rim. Seen from the bench at midday with the roof fully open, a pastel sky and distant elegant towers visible above the rim. No people in the foreground.
